results: Requirement N38 verified: Local data locations, export/deletion/retention/backup/recovery, supported profiles and maintenance/dependency policy authoritatively documented in docs/release/SERVICE_POLICY.md and docs/release/MAINTENANCE.md.
Zero hosted subscription and no unearned SLA explicitly codified in SERVICE_POLICY.md: no paid core features, no proprietary cloud accounts, and operator-managed local-first availability.
Exhaustive local data layout documented for .local-data/: manifest.json, content-addressed objects/<hash>, staging write-ahead directory, and SQLite metadata database (policyhelix.db).

Crash recovery at staged-byte/manifest boundary verified: ReconcileStartup cleans orphaned staging files (.staging/) and temporary manifest files (manifest.json.tmp), leaving only the complete prior valid state exposed.

Operation replay and lost ACK deduplication verified: replaying identical write request returns stored receipt with zero duplicate side effects; replaying with conflicting payload is rejected with ErrOperationConflict.
Storage quota limits (MaxTotalRecords) and disk exhaustion fail closed without partial state writes.
Supported operational profiles (local-demo vs self-hosted production) formally specified.
Synthetic C38 positive and negative fixtures authoritatively inventoried under tests/fixtures/policyhelix/C38/manifest.json and verified against byte-exact SHA-256 digests.
Dedicated Go integration tests in tests/c38_service_policy_test.go passed cleanly.
All acceptance criteria and negative cases from plans/commits/C38.md proven with automated tests on the selected engine and web tools.
